Content fixtures for the end-to-end tests (`playwright.config.ts` points
`HERALD_CONTENT_DIR` here). They are not published reporting and never ship with the site.

Story text is illustrative and asserts no real reporting, interviews or quotes. Images in
`media/`: `edition-70.jpg` is the 70th edition's cover; `the-scene.jpg` and `interview.jpg`
are photographs from a supplied Facebook PDF; `campus.jpg` is
[Tim Alex on Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-walking-on-pathway-in-front-of-brown-concrete-building-during-daytime-JYqLCa-rv7o)
(a stock placeholder, not KMLA) and `library.jpg` is
[Emil Widlund on Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/assorted-books-ZtI4l8EvyUw).
